description: This file defines a template class for HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) using various hash algorithms. It includes methods for setting the key, resetting the state, computing the result, and inputting data. It also defines specific typedefs for common hash algorithms like SHA1, SHA224, SHA256, SHA384, SHA512, and MD5.

classes.name: HMACType
classes.description: A template class implementing HMAC with a specified hash algorithm, providing key setting, input, reset, and result retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Sets the HMAC key, hashing it if necessary, and prepares inner and outer pads.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal hash algorithm state and initializes it with the inner pad.

methods.name: Result
methods.description: Returns the computed HMAC value, performing final hashing if not already done.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Feeds data into the hash algorithm for HMAC computation.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Allows streaming data into the HMAC object for hashing.
